subject: Clarify MSA redlines and Ariba onboarding acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Maya Stevens <maya.stevens@northpointhealth.com>

Cc: procurement-portal@northpointhealth.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — few questions before Ariba enrollment

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the call yesterday. We're ready to move forward with Redwood but ran into three things while preparing our Ariba enrollment:

1) Our procurement team needs the MSA language to explicitly state the "PO acceptance" behavior — they want to confirm whether a PO acceptance in Ariba constitutes "acceptance" under the contract or if a signed order form is required.

2) There's a signer-delegation question: our finance team requires a signature matrix PDF and confirmation of which roles can approve order forms on behalf of Redwood.

3) Ariba needs a sample of the Order Form payload so they can map PO lines (unit-of-measure, SKU, and tax fields).

I've attached our internal checklist and the draft redline for your legal team to review (see NPH_MSA_redline_v3.docx and NPH_OrderForm_AribaSpec.xlsx). Can you confirm next steps and an ETA for responses? We aim to complete Ariba activation by 06/10.

-Maya
Maya Stevens

NorthPoint Health

- Me: I'll coordinate the Ariba mapping call and confirm the 06/10 activation timeline with your portal team.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form — few questions before Ariba enrollment

Laura / Monica — I reviewed NPH_MSA_redline_v3.docx and have the following suggested approach so we don't block Ariba activation: 

1) PO acceptance: keep the MSA clause but add a short clarifying sentence to the Order Form section: "A Customer purchase order (including via procurement portals such as Ariba) will be deemed acceptance of the Order Form when the purchase order references the applicable Order Form and contains the essential commercial terms (SKU, quantity, price). For avoidance of doubt, mutual signature is not required where the parties have agreed to portal-based purchase order acceptance in writing."

Rationale: this preserves Redwood's requirement for clear commercial terms while enabling portal-driven workflows. If NorthPoint insists on mutual signatures, that will require an operational exception and will slow activation.

2) Signer matrix: Attached are two options — "signature_matrix.pdf" (preferred) that describes role-level authority (e.g., VP Finance, Procurement Director) and a fallback position where we permit delegated e-signing by named roles only. Note: we should avoid open-ended "any authorized person" language.

3) PO payload mapping: Monica — please generate an example PO export with columns: PO_Number, Line_Number, SKU, Description, UOM, Quantity, Unit_Price, Tax_Code, Tax_Amount, Total_Line, Supplier_Partner_ID. Highlight any fields that Redwood will ignore in ingestion.

I'll draft the concise MSA patch language and send a one-page summary to Laura by lunchtime.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
Attachment: signature_matrix.pdf (pdf)

Subject: RE: MSA + Order Form — few questions before Ariba enrollment

Hi Maya — following up with consolidated answers and attachments. 

Summary of responses (see attachments):
- MSA language: we propose the small clarifying clause in the Order Form section that treats a PO issued via Ariba as acceptance when it references the Order Form and includes essential commercial terms. (See attached redline excerpt titled "MSA_patch_PO_acceptance.txt" inside NPH_MSA_redline_v3.docx).
- Signer matrix: attaching signature_matrix.pdf showing Redwood-authorized roles. If NorthPoint needs specific named delegates we can map those at activation time, but we prefer role-based delegation to avoid repeated amendments.
- PO payload: attached is an example export (NPH_OrderForm_AribaSpec.xlsx) and a cleaned CSV sample for ingestion. Key fields we require: PO_Number, Line_Number, SKU, UOM, Quantity, Unit_Price, Tax_Code. Optional fields we will ignore: internal_invoice_notes.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the MSA patch language by EOD 05/26 if you want us to proceed with Ariba activation on 06/10.
2) Schedule mapping call: Monica proposed Wed 05/26 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET — does that work for your portal team? If not, propose two alternate slots.

Forwarding the attachments for your team to upload into Ariba and for your legal ops to review. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk Markus' language if helpful.

Best,
Laura
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
